project.name: Competition Radar Automation Hub
project.purpose: Local-first automation control plane for competitor intelligence and shipment tracking with one durable queue, one shared Playwright runtime, and Supabase/Postgres persistence.

validation: real durable-queue shipment and competition runs

dependencies: Zod strict allowlists and versioned payloads

facts: All browser work is represented by strict versioned jobs: competitor_discovery, competitor_scrape, or shipment_tracking; arbitrary URLs, JavaScript, shell commands, and handler names are rejected.
The Postgres automation_jobs table and service-role-only claim, heartbeat, and stale-recovery functions are the durable queue source of truth.

The automation_settings row is the organization-scoped source of truth for running or paused state, competitor scrape interval, and maximum parallel jobs; switching accounts does not change another organization's policy.

A durable pause is written before active jobs are cancelled and is enforced by Inngest dispatch, the shipment scheduler, and the SQL claim function so recurring work cannot immediately recreate or claim jobs.
Per-organization concurrency is enforced while claiming jobs in Postgres; AUTOMATION_CONCURRENCY remains only the process-wide safety ceiling.
Competition scraping and shipment tracking share one lazy BrowserLauncher and concurrency budget; the legacy shipment monitor is not started by server.ts.
Browser mode is adaptive: headed minimized/off-screen real Chrome on Windows and headless Chromium on Linux, with optional proxy support.
Shipment provider adapters use fixed HTTPS URL templates; cookie consent is accepted, obstructive popups are dismissed, and CAPTCHA pauses only the affected provider/workflow.
Normalized shipment status is deterministic; OpenAI is optional and may improve presentation but cannot change the selected status.
TorqueCore integration is a live bridge that imports remote shipment requests into the local queue and writes normalized status/results back to its Supabase project.
Electron is the tray supervisor, keeps renderer isolation enabled, prevents external navigation, and stores optional local secrets through safeStorage.

The Automation Hub exposes organization-scoped process, queue, and event state. Cancelling an active job aborts its isolated Playwright context; job history can be deleted only after active work is stopped.
Owner-only entity deletion cancels matching queued or running jobs before database cascades remove competitor stores, products, and their dependent records.
The real regression track 1Z0R6D896828244757 must classify as info_received (UPS label created), not delivered; this is covered by a regression test and a live run.
Server-only credentials must never be NEXT_PUBLIC variables or returned by health endpoints/logs.
Unrelated user changes in .claude/settings.local.json and supabase/.temp/cli-latest must be preserved and excluded from commits.
